model_name_en: Physics-deep learning hybrid framework (dual-branch gating + stacking fusion)
modal_decomposition: moving-average three-frequency decomposition; top 2 modal components retained per base variable
modal_features: For each base variable, low/mid/high components are scored on the training split and the top 2 are retained.
stacking: Validation-stage linear blend of TCN-Transformer and GRU-Transformer outputs plus intercept.
